scope: No complete symbol/date acquisition-outcome review has been established. Empty reviews intentionally certify no negatives.
complete_review_requires: Explicit symbol and exchange-session window from feature close through the tenth subsequent session close.
Verified historical security identity for that symbol across the window, including ticker changes, share class, and ADS terms.
Documented search method with source locator (registry query, filing search, or named primary sources).
Statement that no qualifying public-target acquisition announcement with a measured >=15% close-to-close reaction was found inside the window.
Retention of any borderline public processes, rumors, or non-qualifying deals as unresolved rather than negative.
review.complete set true only after the above are satisfied; incomplete searches never invent label 0.
